text: Non-Chinese citizens, in good physical and mental health.Applicants seeking a bachelor's degree should possess a high school diploma or equivalent qualifications, demonstrate outstanding academic performance, and generally be under the age of 25 years.Applicants seeking a master's degree should possess a bachelor's degree or equivalent qualifications, demonstrate outstanding academic performance, and generally be under the age of 35 years.Applicants seeking a doctoral degree should possess a master's degree or equivalent qualifications, demonstrate outstanding academic performance, and generally be under the age of 40 years.Applicants seeking bachelor's, master's, or doctoral degrees with Chinese as the medium of instruction should have Chinese proficiency at least at Level 4 of the Hanyu Shuiping Kaoshi (HSK).Applicants seeking bachelor's, master's, or doctoral degrees with English as the medium of instruction should have an English proficiency level of at least 5.5 in IELTS, 72 in TOEFL, or 100 in Duolingo.
